summary: Fixed gridcalc: column indexing, number exponents, power/prefix precedence and right-grouping, range normalisation, empty cells, %.10g number text, SUM-family text skipping, lazy IF, bool typing, cell ordering, refs dedupe, ROUND on large values, and sheet line trimming. All unit tests and tools/check.py pass; overview.md 3.2 says -2^2 is 4, which contradicts formulas.md, the changelog and 3.4 (-4), so I followed formulas.md.
